verdict.rationale: No explicit TTL or expiration-date API is documented. There are indirect signals that stale facts get handled: memories are non-permanent by default unless flagged `isStatic: true`, the comparison page criticizes alternatives for lacking 'temporal truth' (implying Supermemory supersedes outdated facts), and metadata filtering by date lets developers exclude old memories at query time. These pieces imply rather than document decay or expiry, so delivery is partial. missing for 10: explicit TTL/expiration-date parameters, documented recency weighting or decay behavior for non-static memories, independent or hands-on corroboration that stale facts stop surfacing.
